test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

The manager **discussed on the issue** in detail.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "discussed on the issue" is grammatically incorrect as the verb "discuss" does not require a preposition like "on."
 
• The correct usage is "discussed the issue," which directly follows the verb with the object.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager discussed the issue in detail."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "discussed about the issue" – Incorrect due to redundancy, as "discuss" does not require "about."
 
• **Option 3:** "explained the issue" – Incorrect as it alters the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** "talked over the issue" – Incorrect as it is less formal and changes the tone of the sentence.
